root_cause.text: The `region_count` local variable in `create_log_context()` is declared as a 32-bit `unsigned int` instead of a 64-bit `sector_t`, causing integer truncation of the value returned by `dm_sector_div_up()` which leads to under-allocated bitsets and subsequent out-of-bounds writes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes the type of `region_count` from `unsigned int` to `sector_t` and adds an explicit check `if (region_count > UINT_MAX)` to prevent overflow before it is used to allocate the bitsets.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a boundary check to ensure the calculated region count does not exceed the maximum unsigned integer limit.
